decisions.reason: As a nearby extension of the firm’s decorative woodcraft range, it is likely kept while management learns from early market feedback, though the added electronic complexity and narrower motif make it the most at risk if results fall below aspirations.
This product fits the firm’s established seasonal wooden décor business very closely, so with no clear sign of underperformance and some organisational slack, management would likely continue it.
